(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (paint-runs r)
      (let loop ([c 0] [out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
        (cond [(>= c (cols g)) out]
              [(= (at g r c) 0) (loop (+ c 1) out)]
              [else
               (let* ((color (at g r c))
                      (end (let find-end ([cc c])
                             (if (and (< cc (cols g)) (= (at g r cc) color))
                                 (find-end (+ cc 1))
                                 (- cc 1))))
                      (mid (+ c (quotient (+ (- end c) 1) 2))))
                 (loop (+ end 1) (set-cell out r mid color)))])))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
      (for*/fold ([acc out])
                 ([c (in-range (cols g))])
        (let ((v (at (paint-runs r) r c)))
          (if (not (= v 0)) (set-cell acc r c v) acc))))))
